Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.

Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.58 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 363 W·min/l (5% below healthy). No internal bypassing detected; volumetric efficiency is optimal.
Accumulator: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.5 bar (2% below healthy). Pressure stability and surge dampening meet full design specifications.
